system.name: SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2)
system.one_liner: A foundation model for promptable segmentation in images and videos with streaming memory, trained on the SA-V dataset built by a data engine.

content.variant_note: three lettered panels for task, model and data, tied by dotted leaders: film strips in and out, a block diagram, and a data-engine loop beside a dataset card
content.argues: The paper offers a promptable video segmentation task, a streaming-memory model and a large dataset built by a data engine as one package.
content.subject: prompted film strips to masks, the SAM 2 block diagram with memory, a data-engine loop and the SA-V card

lessons.what_to_learn: Present a paper's three deliverables as a task, model, data triptych whose captions start with a bold category word, and tie the model box in each panel together with dotted leaders so the black box in the task panel opens into the architecture in the next.
lessons.suits: Papers that release a task, a model and a dataset together, especially video or sequence tasks that can show prompts and results on film strips.

evidence: Our work includes a task, model, and dataset (see Fig. 1).
SAM 2 is capable of interactively segmenting regions through prompts (clicks, boxes, or masks) on one or multiple video frames

summary: SAM 2 is a foundation model for promptable segmentation in images and videos, with a streaming memory and a new large video dataset. Figure 1 presents the paper's task, model and data as three lettered panels joined by dotted leaders. Panel (a) shows a cat video as a film strip with a box, clicks and a mask as prompts, a grey model box, and an output strip with the cat masked in every frame. Panel (b) opens the model into pastel modules: prompt encoder, image encoder, memory attention, memory bank and mask decoder. Panel (c) shows the model, annotate, data, train loop and the SA-V dataset card with 642.6 K masklets, 35.5 M masks, 50.9 K videos and 196.0 hours.
